about: How a film carries its one idea. A device with scenes can be drawn by the kit today; one without waits for the kit to learn it (later) and is never offered. plain: it is only the usual scene, so any device that does something comes first. news: yes, cond or no, for the day the idea step reaches the news program (owner's decision, not yet taken). rungs: the ladder's steps it serves (concept.RUNGS). Brand-neutral: no client's word here.

yardstick.use: a number has no body: stand it beside something of public, constant size

too-tall.use: a ratio too large for one screen: the camera climbs a bar

unit-array.use: a countable 2-30 shown as that many marks

scale-steps.use: the story spans scales: each step zooms by the same ratio

object-becomes-chart.use: a thing is also a quantity: it turns into the chart

data-resort.use: the same items, a new grouping: marks keep their identity

persistent-object.use: one drawn object recurs through the film and carries an abstract story

one-take-world.use: many steps in one world: the camera moves, the cuts vanish

state-change.use: the same thing before and after: what differs is the story

graphic-match.use: two facts share a shape: one cuts to the other

motion-bridge.use: any cut: the motion starts right after it

object-wipe.use: a story's own object crosses the frame and makes the cut

map-flight.use: place carries the story: fly to it

clean-map.use: a plain map with one area filled

route-arc.use: something travels from one place to another

before-after-wipe.use: a visible physical change between two dated pictures

space-time-board.use: several stated events on a clock or a line

document-close-up.use: a law or a decision: the line itself, boxed

evidence-stack.use: a claim proved by a chain of items, one by one

verbatim-quote.use: a person's exact words as the object

material-film.use: one film in one drawn material

period-pastiche.use: history in the look of its period

cut-out-collage.use: cut-out things moving on jointed parts

rostrum-move.use: a slow move to one telling detail of a picture

parallax.use: a wide place shot on depth planes

treated-picture.use: the subject's texture behind the type

exploded-model.use: how a thing works: its parts apart, in order

drawn-reveal.use: the object draws itself on screen

empty-hold.use: the peak fact alone on an empty canvas

rewatch-detail.use: a small detail for the second watch

silhouette-witness.use: an abstract figure for an anonymous voice

phone-recreation.use: a mock screen, labelled as an example
